<!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 -->

## Highlights

_See the complete change list below._

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- Adds an operator-scoped model.catalogRefresh setting and lets privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled: false stop background catalog refreshes while local metadata remains available. ([#16066](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16066)) by @yiliang114
- feat(managed-agent): support full model configuration at session creation ([#16153](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16153)) by @doudouOUC
- When experimental.unifiedAgentLoop is enabled, ACP Goal turns run on the shared agent loop with shared rounds, tool batches, and stop points. ([#16131](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16131)) by @qqqys
- Adds a Channel events page to Web Shell with a filterable, auto-refreshing timeline of Channel activity, skip reasons, replies, task transitions, and poll results. ([#16106](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16106)) by @wenshao
- Adds a local /verify-pr Docker recipe that runs untrusted PR code in a container while keeping model credentials on the host through a chat-completion proxy. ([#16077](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16077)) by @wenshao
- Runs Mods prompt.submit hooks in the Ink terminal before typed prompts are processed, allowing hooks to see composer text with pasted content expanded. ([#16180](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16180)) by @qqqys
- Adds a managed Web Shell host entry, improves managed empty-state layout, and consolidates session-failure and unconfirmed-submission notices above the composer. ([#15928](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15928)) by @yiliang114
- Adds Settings → Connections → Allow remote connections to qwen serve, enabling remote access, token use, and client disconnects without restarting. ([#15887](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15887)) by @yiliang114
- With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, ACP cron and background-notification turns now use the shared agent loop for consistent rounds, tool batching, and stopping. ([#16190](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16190)) by @qqqys
- Workspace uploads can now proceed concurrently while still rejecting occupied destinations and preserving directory occupancy protections. ([#16212](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16212)) by @doudouOUC
- GitHub events for bound PRs now go to the associated session as untrusted prompts, and replies stay private unless published. ([#16117](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16117)) by @wenshao
- Web Shell channel editor can now edit GitHub repository access, mention behavior, and notification polling settings instead of requiring manual settings changes. ([#16149](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16149)) by @wenshao

### Bug Fixes

- Pins the RHEL 10 EPEL bootstrap RPM and makes desktop smoke teardown treat Linux zombie processes as stopped while still reporting live daemon failures. ([#16154](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16154)) by @yiliang114
- Compacts live ACP tool-result displays for session replay, so large file edit results show a saved-session preview instead of full old and new contents. ([#16172](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16172)) by @wenshao
- Fixes PR review endpoint routing by selecting the cohort before the model and reports the final bucket, cohort, model, and endpoint hostname. ([#16151](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16151)) by @yiliang114
- fix(serve): keep record_artifact guidance out of Managed Runtime worker results ([#16148](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16148)) by @wenshao
- Binds web-shell config synchronization to the current attachment so config writes made by the first prompt are no longer silently discarded. ([#16170](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16170)) by @wenshao
- Fixes tool-choice failures on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1, and Mythos 5.1 by avoiding unsupported forced tool selection. ([#15558](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15558)) by @Adkid-Zephyr
- Fixes Web Shell pasting so a single copied image with an HTTP(S) URL attaches the image, while unavailable file pastes show a warning. ([#16179](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16179)) by @ytahdn
- Requires explicit folder trust before repository-supplied hooks, permission grants, and project language servers can run, improving safety for untrusted projects. ([#16182](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16182)) by @yiliang114
- Anthropic-compatible requests now honor the configured transport timeout and dispatcher, preventing premature request aborts when a longer API timeout is set. ([#16193](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16193)) by @yiliang114
- Remote-access error handling now hides internal error details from callers and fixes several reviewed reliability and security defects. ([#16199](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16199)) by @yiliang114
- On touch devices, navigation now keeps focus on the chat pane instead of opening the composer keyboard, while desktop focus behavior remains unchanged. ([#16198](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16198)) by @ytahdn
- The bundled Generated UI MCP server now runs correctly in Node mode when the CLI is launched from an Electron-based IDE companion. ([#16064](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16064)) by @yar3333
- ACP bridge operations that finish alongside long-lived session or channel events now clean up their results instead of retaining them. ([#15347](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15347)) by @Sumire-no-kai
- Ordinary workspace execution, member release, and file rewind no longer take the tenant-wide placement lock, reducing cross-workspace blocking. ([#16205](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16205)) by @doudouOUC
- Embedded-webview bundle guard failures now show a readable assertion naming the forbidden marker instead of crashing on a large diff. ([#16210](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16210)) by @yiliang114
- Project hooks in .qwen/settings.json now require explicit folder or workspace trust in interactive sessions and show a warning when withheld. ([#16196](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16196)) by @yiliang114
- OpenRouter IDs with :exacto now keep the base model name, so qwen/qwen3-coder:exacto gets its 262,144-token window instead of 200K. ([#16165](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16165)) by @Shizoqua
- Shell permission analysis now treats grep -n and grep --line-number as flags, so grep file reads are still checked. ([#14383](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14383)) by @kabishou11
- Monitor and workflow completion notifications are attributed to the registering turn, letting active-turn results reach the next model request sooner. ([#16177](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16177)) by @yiliang114
- Makes CI sandbox image builds more reliable on hosts with slow default Debian mirrors by switching to a faster mirror only when speed checks require it. ([#16218](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16218)) by @yiliang114
- Scopes GitHub, GitLab, and DWS polling cursors to each workspace, preserving existing positions on upgrade while storing channel state with stricter permissions. ([#16231](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16231)) by @wenshao
- Improves CI apt mirror selection by preferring the VPC intranet mirror and switching when a candidate is fast enough, even if the default mirror seems acceptable. ([#16260](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16260)) by @yiliang114
- Fixes RHEL 10 desktop smoke tests by running them headless without requiring Xvfb. ([#16211](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16211)) by @yiliang114

### Performance

- Managed Agent resident Runtime Session claim and release no longer wait on the tenant placement lock, improving resident runtime performance without changing success behavior. ([#16217](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16217)) by @doudouOUC
- Managed Agent turn submission admission and migration preparation avoid the tenant placement lock where safe, reducing wait time without changing request outcomes. ([#16223](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16223)) by @doudouOUC
- Standalone Harness admission, recovery, cleanup, and Hook admission checks no longer take the tenant placement lock, improving Managed Agent performance with unchanged verdicts. ([#16221](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16221)) by @doudouOUC
- Speeds up local Workspace file reads, uploads, and status checks by reusing CLI capability probes when local CLI identity is unchanged. ([#16229](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16229)) by @doudouOUC
- Improves Session responsiveness by reducing locking for common commands such as model changes, approvals, context compression, task cancel, and renames. ([#16225](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16225)) by @doudouOUC

### Documentation

- Release documentation now explains why publish can remain queued on GitHub-hosted runners and why those steps are not moved to ECS pools. ([#16194](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16194)) by @yiliang114
- Managed Agent structure-review documentation now reflects the completed store decomposition and current audit status. ([#16230](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16230)) by @wenshao

### Internal Changes

- Adds an /autofix-pr chain test for rerunning a timed-out job when the rerun answer is lost. ([#16138](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16138)) by @wenshao
- Makes Local, SSH, Kubernetes, External, and Static runtime backends optional so embedded servers can include only needed backends; pending operations resume when available. ([#16141](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16141)) by @doudouOUC
- Simplifies managed-agent row locking and runtime verification while preserving session, turn, journal, and checkpoint validation order. ([#16139](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16139)) by @doudouOUC
- Refactors internal Managed Agent session-store consumers to narrower role interfaces without changing user-visible behavior. ([#16121](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16121)) by @wenshao
- Adds regression tests covering removal of active persistent permission rules, including post-removal decisions and preservation of unrelated rules. ([#13818](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13818)) by @TYY-2005
- Pins hook telemetry redaction tests with value-level assertions so future raw-text properties fail instead of leaking. ([#11785](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11785)) by @RunMintOn
- Reserves Hosted integration-test ports below ephemeral ranges to reduce port conflicts and improve test reliability. ([#16174](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16174)) by @wenshao
- Adds a regression test ensuring completed background shell notifications reach the next model request in the same turn without starting extra notification turns. ([#16176](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16176)) by @yiliang114
- ci(e2e): run the nightly suite with the unified agent loop on ([#16192](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16192)) by @qqqys
- Managed Agent's shared MySQL schema now follows documented conventions for identifiers, booleans, counters, indexes, and digests, improving SQL consistency. ([#16143](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16143)) by @doudouOUC
- EmbeddedRuntimeBroker now depends only on SessionQueryStore, simplifying Managed Agent internals without changing user-facing behavior. ([#16216](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16216)) by @wenshao
- Integration tests now install the local extension fixture from a dedicated subdirectory, fixing E2E failures caused by copying the extension store into itself. ([#16222](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16222)) by @yiliang114
- Improves managed-agent test reliability by refreshing Workspace owner membership expectations for concurrent sessions. ([#16240](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16240)) by @doudouOUC
- Fixes ACP parity tests by keeping session runtime state out of the compared workspace directory. ([#16224](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16224)) by @yiliang114

<!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 -->

## Highlights

_See the complete change list below._

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- Adds bounded SQL history queries for Managed local H2 and Hosted MySQL, enabling paged recent messages, journal transactions, and exact operation or command lookups. ([#15839](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15839)) by @doudouOUC
- Enables Generated UI by default and lets users continue chatting with interactive card values attached as removable context above the composer. ([#15856](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15856)) by @qqqys
- feat(web-shell): keyboard shortcuts for Session Overview and Split View ([#14179](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14179)) by @4ekuct25
- Adds a Russian locale for the Web Shell Goal card and Goals dialog, with English fallback for untranslated strings. ([#13685](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13685)) by @4ekuct25
- Extends Web Shell one-click daemon updates to pnpm, yarn, bun, and sudo-prefixed npm installs, and shows manual steps when automatic update is unavailable. ([#15849](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15849)) by @wenshao
- Web Shell and Qwen Code Desktop now show active background agent counts in the status-bar task pill while agents are running. ([#14002](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14002)) by @4ekuct25
- Managed WebShell now reads the latest 100 live items directly and pages upward for older messages, while live updates continue. ([#15865](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15865)) by @doudouOUC
- The /verify-pr local flow now reuses the current working tree only when it is a clean checkout of the PR head and records round details. ([#15913](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15913)) by @wenshao
- Archived conversations in Settings now show Export conversation and Restore inline beside More, making archive management faster. ([#15872](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15872)) by @deggs7
- PR watch now merges a stale base before attempting fixes when CI failures may be caused by the branch being behind. ([#15922](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15922)) by @wenshao
- Adds an experimental one-command Helm deployment for Managed Agent with Hosted Harness, MySQL, local execution, and an authenticated gateway. ([#15492](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15492)) by @doudouOUC
- Adds --in-place mode to the PR-watch skill to co-drive in your checkout, push the branch, and reply on the PR. ([#15929](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15929)) by @wenshao
- Keeps skill slash-command argument hints visible while typing and shrinks them to missing arguments. ([#15930](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15930)) by @wenshao
- Makes context memory files in the Context Usage panel clickable to open read-only previews such as AGENTS.md. ([#15932](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15932)) by @wenshao
- Makes autofix-pr post a pull-request comment when a round is blocked, stating what was attempted, what blocks it, and what human action is needed. ([#15978](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15978)) by @wenshao
- Adds a retry budget to /autofix-pr so a check left failing after three fix pushes is handed to a human and shown in /autofix-pr status. ([#15985](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15985)) by @wenshao
- Adds a Workflow switch in Web Shell, split panes, and VS Code chat to update saved session Workflow preferences for the next turn without interrupting responses. ([#15779](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15779)) by @qqqys
- Enables channel adapters to expose tools to agent sessions and adds QQ moderation tools, including recall, mute, kick, and join approval, controlled by moderationTools. ([#14348](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14348)) by @Eric-GoodBoy-Tech
- Adds a batch request and SDK method to fetch live-session snapshots for up to 20 selected workspaces in one call. ([#12513](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12513)) by @XIQIXIQIXIQI
- feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery ([#11486](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11486)) by @XIQIXIQIXIQI
- Improves the bundled code-review skill by re-anchoring after head drift, running actionlint checks, accounting for blockers, and refusing retries. ([#16001](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16001)) by @wenshao

### Bug Fixes

- Hardens the managed-agent upgrade command's check, backup, install, start, and verify phases, including cleanup after interrupted installs. ([#15853](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15853)) by @wenshao
- TUI CI now runs impact-selected checks and reserves full source TUI acceptance for nightly runs, manual dispatch, and high-risk changes. ([#15864](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15864)) by @yiliang114
- Main pushes now run one macOS E2E shard instead of two, while schedules, manual dispatch, and feat/e2e branches keep the two-shard matrix. ([#15873](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15873)) by @yiliang114
- The Web Shell floating approval card for tool approvals now uses a single scroll region, avoiding nested scrollbars in long diffs. ([#14621](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14621)) by @4ekuct25
- Release builds and eligible downstream jobs now use labelled runners on existing ECS hosts to reduce hosted-runner queue delays. ([#15832](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15832)) by @yiliang114
- CUA input, window selection, and session cleanup align with 0.27.0 across CUA SDK, Browser SDK, and Node REPL for more reliable sessions. ([#15784](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15784)) by @LaZzyMan
- Review command tests now pin ghApiAllNested pagination and response merging behavior to prevent regressions in GitHub API requests. ([#12560](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12560)) by @indexGin
- The No-workspace sessions header now matches Pinned, Workspaces, and Recent with consistent height, muted text, spacing, chevron, and hover/focus behavior. ([#15897](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15897)) by @deggs7
- E2E builds now use the same pool-first runner routing and disk gate as other jobs, reducing hosted queue delays for post-merge test signals. ([#15885](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15885)) by @yiliang114
- Web Shell browser smoke tests now run on isolated ubuntu-latest runners to avoid shared-runner network failures. ([#15886](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15886)) by @yiliang114
- Web Shell now hides the No-workspace sessions sidebar section when it loads empty, matching Pinned behavior. ([#15916](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15916)) by @deggs7
- fix(web-shell): keep "+ Add session" clickable when the catalog is empty ([#15835](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15835)) by @2SinceJuly
- fix(ci): weight PR owner assignment by open issue load ([#15194](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15194)) by @DragonnZhang
- fix(cli): separate instruction files from auto memory in context usage ([#15863](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15863)) by @callmeYe
- fix(core): skip memory imports of files already loaded as context files ([#15687](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15687)) by @tneemo
- fix(core): retry bodyless 400 responses instead of treating them as fail-fast ([#15821](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15821)) by @Andrea-Bruno
- fix(cli): share hosted harness deadlines and bail after CI retries ([#14752](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14752)) by @zonemeen
- fix(web-shell): prune split panes whose session left the active catalog ([#14577](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14577)) by @4ekuct25
- fix(core): stop the session LSP client on Config shutdown ([#14778](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14778)) by @he-yufeng
- Session messaging guidance now explains safe-mode suppression or missing peer addresses without implying recipients do not exist. ([#13948](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13948)) by @haomint
- Memory writes now report omitted index entries and scan-cap omissions separately, with sample names and preserved warnings. ([#14937](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14937)) by @jabrailkhalil
- Web Shell tool-card diffs now wrap long lines so diffs with long comments or paths scroll vertically instead of showing per-line horizontal scrollbars. ([#13272](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13272)) by @ifan855
- /context now displays token counts of one million or more as millions in terminal, plain text, and OpenTUI views. ([#13237](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13237)) by @Shizoqua
- Fixed a CLI test-suite build failure by completing the settle-budget rename in hosted harness tests. ([#15935](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15935)) by @wenshao
- The sandboxed /verify-pr publisher now runs the artifact check itself and marks the round inconclusive if the check fails or cannot run. ([#15938](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15938)) by @wenshao
- Startup probe now separates broker write failures from wrong topic type, giving clearer fail-fast guidance and mqadmin remedy. ([#15941](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15941)) by @wenshao
- Fixes /verify-pr publishing to use the newest round and updates skill text to match CI harness-fault behavior. ([#15966](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15966)) by @wenshao
- Queues peer-controller registry writes from the same process before taking the cross-process file lock to reduce lock contention and make concurrent updates more reliable. ([#15971](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15971)) by @wenshao
- fix(managed-agent): stop a drained pool owner's not-found from retiring automations ([#15990](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15990)) by @wenshao
- Routes helper-test temporary files to the runner data-disk temp directory to prevent CI failures caused by a small host /tmp tmpfs. ([#15979](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15979)) by @yiliang114
- Exempts non-TUI package trees from the parity and no-flicker gates so PRs touching only them skip those lanes. ([#15937](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15937)) by @yiliang114
- Fixes session-commit registration when an absolute cd or pushd resolves to the same repository or a subdirectory, keeping commits tracked. ([#15953](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15953)) by @yiliang114
- isAoneHostFamily now uses the shared host normalizer so review remote matching and write routing judge Aone hosts consistently. ([#15934](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15934)) by @yiliang114
- fix(vscode): gate the companion vitest worker cap on the shared pool ([#15940](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15940)) by @yiliang114
- Peer-controller registry writers now wait up to 8s for a contended lock and can take over a crashed holder's lock without losing writes. ([#15992](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15992)) by @wenshao
- The CLI now requests consent for native extension commands before direct installation in OpenTUI; replacement or unmount cancels pending requests. ([#15947](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15947)) by @chiga0
- Fixes managed-agent cancellation, Maven embedding, Hosted fault testing, and SDK stream-idle recovery so verification flows behave reliably. ([#15927](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15927)) by @doudouOUC
- Makes each /verify round publish and update only its own status comment instead of overwriting other verification comments. ([#15988](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15988)) by @wenshao
- Fixes deep-verification reports so the verdict line stays a plain paragraph and the published comment is verified against the intended body. ([#16002](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16002)) by @wenshao
- Adds the missing development proxy for autofix-pr routes so the PR watches page reaches the daemon. ([#16004](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16004)) by @wenshao
- Updates MCP client and core to 2.4.0 to drop pre-bundled fast-uri 3.1.0 and improve dependency auditability. ([#15925](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15925)) by @yiliang114
- Uses the automatic GitHub job token for release publish checkout, reducing authentication failures while keeping PAT for branch push and release creation. ([#15730](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15730)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
- Adds isolation so /verify-pr mutation matrix runs in its own tree and never on live measured cells. ([#15999](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15999)) by @wenshao
- Fixes /verify-pr PR badge binding when a flag is glued directly to the PR number, such as 15979--publish. ([#15989](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15989)) by @wenshao
- Extends built-in reasoning effort to DeepSeek-V4 and new Qwen prefixes while keeping explicit overrides. ([#15987](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15987)) by @wenshao
- Reports a registry that keeps changing during a write as PeerControllerError with code registry-changed and a retry message. ([#16007](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16007)) by @wenshao

### Performance

- Release builds now reuse verified native audio prebuilds from matching successful main releases to skip redundant native builds. ([#15854](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15854)) by @yiliang114

### Documentation

- Managed agent upgrade docs now state that SIGKILL skips cleanup and leaves a temporary upgrade directory that operators should remove. ([#15878](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15878)) by @wenshao
- Updated CI documentation to match the actual qwen-autofix job timeout and worst-case budget values. ([#15914](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15914)) by @yiliang114
- Adds a bilingual Managed Agent server configuration reference generated from server metadata to keep it current. ([#15939](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15939)) by @wenshao
- Adds a bilingual Managed Agent design document with a structure review and staged refactor proposal. ([#15942](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15942)) by @wenshao
- Reorganizes the bilingual Managed Agent deployment guide into three tiers for first-time deployments. ([#15944](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15944)) by @wenshao
- Adds documentation proposing scheduled /autofix-pr --in-place rounds that report findings and require explicit approval before editing. ([#15960](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15960)) by @wenshao
- Updates Managed Agent server docs to link setting tables to the generated configuration reference instead of duplicating settings. ([#15965](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15965)) by @wenshao
- Clarifies artifacts.read-timeout documentation to qualify storage stall behavior and retain the per-row lease note. ([#15980](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15980)) by @wenshao
- Managed-agent docs now note that private CSI sessions record no committed tool receipts and correct lease wording for artifacts.enabled. ([#16000](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16000)) by @wenshao
- Updates managed-agent documentation to describe extracted collaborators and reconciliation prerequisites without changing behavior. ([#16012](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16012)) by @wenshao
- Documents the ManagedAgentStore setter investigation and its Spring injection findings. ([#16014](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16014)) by @wenshao

### Internal Changes

- Updates Web Shell smoke tests to use the renamed Add workspace dialog and Workspaces sidebar label. ([#15860](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15860)) by @wenshao
- Adds a regression gate for managed-agent failover that verifies recovery when a replacement host loses its first takeover-load reply. ([#15857](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15857)) by @wenshao
- Managed public items, transcripts, recent history, and export now use bounded current-message paging instead of persisted snapshots. ([#15870](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15870)) by @doudouOUC
- Hosted fault tests now use Managed JDBC stores so identity handling matches production and avoids false test failures. ([#15882](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15882)) by @yiliang114
- Web shell test setup now selects the retained radio via keyboard focus and Space, making Generated UI retention checks more stable. ([#15896](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15896)) by @yiliang114
- Hosted recovery and transcript fixtures now follow current cancellation, cleanup, and transcript-event contracts for more reliable managed recovery tests. ([#15899](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15899)) by @yiliang114
- Web shell recovery tests now include transcript coverage and temporary storage routing so recovered sessions show confirmed answers and latest requests. ([#15883](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15883)) by @yiliang114
- Improved managed-agent test reliability by retrying expected 503 projection-pending reads during coordinator restart checks. ([#15910](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15910)) by @yiliang114
- Managed tests now count cancellation takeovers only after successful HTTP acceptance while recording all load attempts. ([#15912](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15912)) by @yiliang114
- Managed Agent Server is now organized into Maven modules while remaining a single executable service. ([#15871](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15871)) by @doudouOUC
- Managed crash-recovery validation now treats targeted cleanup loads as non-resuming recovery while still requiring cancellation takeover. ([#15926](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15926)) by @yiliang114

versions.name: v5.1.59
versions.body:
Runs on senpi 2026.11.2-3: the first message of a new session no longer stalls for several seconds, and agent kill/pkill/killall commands that would hit protected processes are refused. ([#12200](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12200))

### Fixed

- Memory sync refuses a received item on Windows whose working path git cannot stage (at or past MAX_PATH, which git for Windows opens without `core.longpaths`), dropping it with a receipt before anything is rendered instead of failing the sync commit and wedging the device on every resume (#12199). POSIX behaviour is unchanged. ([#12201](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12201))
- The task widget no longer keeps finished team members as `process completed` rows. A member that completes its turn leaves the widget even while its handle stays resident; `/tasks` still lists it and `task_send` still revives it. ([#12160](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12160))
- Memory sync validates an item key before it reaches the working tree, the item store or git, so a peer can no longer land a path outside the memory root or inside the repository's own metadata. A key must be a normalized relative path: `..` and `.` segments, absolute paths, drive and UNC prefixes, backslashes, control and format code points, non-NFC text, over-long keys and segments, Windows device names, trailing dots or spaces, and any component git or a file system would fold to `.git` are refused. A refused item is dropped on its own with a receipt, a log line that carries the key's byte length and the rule rather than the key, and a `rejectedItems` count, while the rest of its batch applies and the cursor advances, so one bad item never pauses a device. Local capture uses the same grammar, never follows a symlink out of the memory root, and a file whose name the grammar refuses is reported instead of sent. A path that is valid but spelled with a different Unicode normalization no longer forks one item into two. ([#12152](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12152), fixes [#12147](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12147))
- After a session starts or resumes, workflow (DAG) views now always receive the current run list before the first turn begins, and a client that reconnects to a running session gets it again, so the desktop workflow view no longer stays empty or stale until something changes. A workflow that was still running when the session closed resumes in the background: its state is shown as soon as it is recovered, and the session's first turn no longer waits for the whole workflow to finish. ([#12122](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12122), fixes [#12113](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12113))
- Memory git commands no longer start git's builtin fsmonitor daemon when your git config turns `core.fsmonitor` on. Every git command memory runs now carries `-c core.fsmonitor=false`, the clean-tree `status`, `add` and `diff` included, so no background daemon outlives git and keeps the memory repository busy. ([#12097](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12097), part of [#10391](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10391))
- `fact verify` no longer skips text inside SVG `<foreignObject>`: the ulw-research tokenizer now parses foreignObject subtrees as HTML (the rest of the SVG stays raw), so fact unit/value mutations there are caught and bare numerals must trace to a chart CSV plot value. ([#12040](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12040), fixes [#11570](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11570))
- `task_output` no longer replays an unchanged status snapshot to the same caller: a repeated peek at a task whose status has not moved returns `no_progress` instead of the full record again, which keeps polling loops from refilling the context with identical output. Thanks to @codeg-dev. ([#7662](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/7662))

### Changed

- Every built-in reasoning default that sat at `medium` or `xhigh` now sits at `high`: the default lane `daily-normal` runs `claude-opus-5-5` at `high` (was `medium`), `daily-heavy` and the Fable 5.5 launch rungs drop `xhigh` for `high`, and `geeky-normal`, the deep-low/unspecified/quick category chains, the OpenCode category catalogs, the builtin agent fallback chains and the model-fallback default move with them. Model ids, provider orders and the `low`/`max`/`off` levels are untouched. ([#12094](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12094), fixes [#12085](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12085))

### Added

- Add `omo trust ensure --json [--wait] [--lease-pid <pid>]`, answered by the launcher trust stage: it imports within the launch budget, writes the private generation and leases it, so the retention sweep never removes a generation a running process still uses. ([#11969](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11969), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))
- Add the `eval-integrity` shared skill: a read-only audit of whether an eval, benchmark, metric, A/B test, holdout, LLM judge, or user study can support its stated claim, reported under one PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE verdict line. Thanks to @realsigridjin. ([#7593](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/7593))

versions.name: v5.1.55
versions.body:
**remove-ai-slops now names the two Bun scripts the programming skill ships for test work.** Phase 2 runs `check-test-junk.ts` over every in-scope test file and treats its `file:line` findings as category-9 candidates (never automatic cuts); Phase 4b names `mutation-proof.ts` as the command behind the serial apply/run/restore proof it already described. ([#12017](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12017))

**The programming skill ships two Bun scripts that make the test rules mechanical.** `check-test-junk.ts` flags the junk classes a regex can see in touched test files (source greps, prose pins, fixed sleeps, `.only`/`.skip`, self-comparisons, lower-bound cardinalities) with a per-line opt-out, and `mutation-proof.ts` breaks a production owner, runs the named tests, restores the file byte for byte and prints red/green, so "test your test" is one command. ([#11972](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11972))

**remove-ai-slops now prunes junk tests with the same table the programming skill and the gate reviewer use.** Category 9 marks every in-scope test R/F/C/D, proves each deletion or merge by its class's rule (a production mutation for the behavior classes) before the cut, keeps the retention bar, and reports a baseline-red test as a bug instead of deleting it; behavior is locked with gate-passing tests rather than change certificates, and the report carries a Tests Ledger. ([#11968](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11968))

- senpi-task: a message sent to a daemon task while its launch is being recorded keeps its input identity; the task record no longer rolls its `effect_seq` back, and a record rewritten to the same size is no longer read stale (#10708). ([#11946](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11946))

- Internal telemetry maintenance. ([#11882](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11882))

### Fixed

- `omo remote attach` on Windows now reports a stopped OmO device service as not running instead of a raw connection error (#12042). ([#12043](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12043))
- Memory sync on a CLI sign-in recovers after the OS credential store briefly reads empty (a locked keychain, a racing writer). The operations that saw the empty read are still refused, but the next sync pass gets a live account instead of staying off until restart. A real sign-out or credential change still stops sync (#11812). ([#12001](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12001))
- On Windows, `omo host ensure` forwards a private pipe pair through the npm launcher, Bun re-exec, and provisioned-runtime handoff. Both pipe handles travel together on their original stdio slots, and the waiting launcher closes its owned copies after spawning. Invalid or aliased pairs remain null declarations; POSIX socket forwarding is unchanged. ([#11958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11958))
- Memory git failures that end without any output now say how the git process ended (exit code, signal and elapsed time) instead of a bare exit code. On macOS and Linux the signal tells an externally killed git apart from a silent git error; on Windows a killed child reports no signal, so there the elapsed time is the only clue. ([#11945](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11945))
- The compiled-worker relocation test no longer hangs now and then. Its fixture waited on `terminate()` from inside the worker's message handler, which races the worker's own exit and never settles on Bun 1.4.4. It now waits for the worker's clean exit after the ready message, and a timeout failure reports its signal. ([#11941](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11941), fixes [#11940](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11940))
- The maintainer `omob` build now compiles the engine trust helper in its own cargo call, as the release workflows do, so a locally built desktop engine matches the released one. ([#11939](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11939), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))
- Validate retained research source bytes before replacing an extraction and preserve the original capture time when reusing those bytes. ([#11936](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11936))
- Memory `/doctor` no longer tells the user to "fix the cause" of parked facts batches without naming it: the facts check now reads as a plain-words to-do (run `/facts retry` for a transient cause such as a timeout, or the named fix such as setting `memory.facts.model`), followed by the cause counts per parked batch and the newest parked batch's run log path, and `/facts retry` reports how many batches it unparked and whether any parked again, with the cause. ([#11909](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11909), part of [#10897](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10897))
- A skill MCP server's `timeout` (milliseconds, set on the server entry in the skill's `mcp` frontmatter or `mcp.json`) now bounds every direct MCP request: list tools/resources/prompts, call tool, read resource and get prompt. Values outside 1 to 2147483647 ms fall back to the SDK default ([#11869](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11869), carried forward from #7224 by @AceRothstein71)

### Changed

- The `omo-ai` installer and launcher no longer rewrite the Claude Code version the engine advertised on Anthropic OAuth requests: senpi removed that request path together with the declaration the rewrite looked for (senpi#5131), so engine preparation keeps only the compile-safe css-tree data and the RPC stream guard, and an engine without the declaration no longer fails preparation with "unsupported Senpi". ([#11964](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11964))
- Simplified OpenCode agent assembly by removing redundant type assertions and an unused builtin-skill name inventory. Agent mode, override precedence, and skill selection remain unchanged. ([#11870](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11870)) ([#11899](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11899))

### Added

- Categories and agents can set `models_distribution: "round_robin"` alongside `models` to spread new task children across their configured model chains. The default `sequential` policy keeps the existing order. Each child's fallback chain wraps from its selected starting model without repeating models, and continuations keep their current model. ([#11905](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11905))
- `omo remote` checks your OmO sign-in first and stops with one plain line when you are signed out, the keychain is locked or the credential store is unavailable (#11853). ([#11864](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11864))
- `omo remote attach <device>/<session>` shows a session from another device of this account in the attach TUI, observe-only for now: input is refused with "remote input not enabled yet" (#11853). ([#11858](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11858))
- `omo remote status | devices | sessions | enable | disable` shows this account's devices and the sessions on them through the OmO device service, as tables or `--json`, with a typed SDK (`@oh-my-opencode/device-service-core`) over the service's local API v1 underneath (#11853). ([#11857](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11857))
- Computer use (macOS): `type()` into a window that shows another computer or device (Screen Sharing, iPhone Mirroring) sends the keys of the current keyboard layout, since such a window receives key codes rather than typed text; every character is mapped before anything is sent, and a character no key types fails `InvalidKey` with nothing typed. In the background, text into a Screen Sharing window that needs Shift or Option fails `BackgroundUnavailable` before the first key (it takes modifiers from the physical keyboard; use foreground delivery), and `el.type()` never inserts into a remote window. ([#11749](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11749), part of [#11466](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11466))
- Command Code is now offered during setup as a custom provider: when `CMD_API_KEY` (or `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`) is present in the environment, setup writes a keyless models.json provider entry covering both Command Code wires (Anthropic messages and OpenAI-compatible chat completions) and stores the key reference in auth.json, so agents can use Command Code models without manual provider configuration (#11326). ([#11326](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11326))

### Improved

- Simplify agent-usage reminder state reuse without changing reminder caps, delegation suppression or session cleanup. ([#11890](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11890)) ([#11899](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11899))

versions.name: v5.1.51
versions.body:
5.1.49 and 5.1.50 were not published; their changes ship here. Session startup and task RPC attachment no longer wait for task-host liveness probes. Recovery runs independently per host, stops claiming or reviving children after shutdown, and preserves newer ownership claims. ([#11335](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11335)) DAG recovery and workpool reconciliation now wait for that same session-start reconcile (one shared gate) without holding admission, so a paused DAG's revivable child is never judged orphaned and a queued workpool item of an orphaned worker is redelivered rather than marked delivery_uncertain. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) Continuing a synchronous task whose session was already deleted now fails at once with an error saying to start a new task, instead of waiting out the 30-minute sync poll timeout; a sync poll also stops when the server keeps reporting its session as not found. Completed sync task sessions now honor `background_task.taskCleanupDelayMs` instead of a fixed 10 minutes. Reported by @orgito. ([#11524](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11524), fixes [#11520](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11520)) **omo.dev deploys again after the document-shell change.** The `/design` showcase became a root layout of its own and lost the hourly revalidation it used to inherit, so one prerendered page had no expiry and the deploy's asset-retention check refused the build. The design layout revalidates hourly again, within the site's one-hour HTML lifetime. ([#11587](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11587), fixes [#11585](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11585)) Release pull requests no longer fail the changelog gate when fragments for the next release land on the base branch after the cut. ([#11574](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11574)) - Release preparation no longer fails its own command-string audit when changelog fragments have been folded into the changelog. ([#11562](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11562)) **The frontend skill now builds in ten habits that design reviewers check for.** Before designing a new screen, a redesign, or a design system, it reads the guideline source in full, defines the ideal state per persona and journey step, and records every gap in a ledger. Controls keep the same box size in every state, and a spinner or arrow never adds padding. Pointer targets are at least 24 px, colour roles come before components (built from shadcn/ui anatomy), glass and dated trend surfaces stay out unless the brief asks for them, and the subtract pass counts the controls. Every UI or design-system deliverable states a per-criterion WCAG 2.2 AA result. ([#11536](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11536), fixes [#11534](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11534)) **macOS computer use releases the keys and buttons it holds even if the engine dies mid-call.** An input request that presses now starts the engine binary again as a hidden release helper and streams every press, drag move and release to it; when the engine is killed, crashes or a request unwinds with something still held, the helper posts the releases (within 2 seconds) through the same routes, leaving any key or button the user is physically holding to the user. The helper runs in its own session, ignores the hangup and terminate a group kill sends until its releases are out, and refuses to run unless the engine that spawned it is its parent and the stream carries its per-spawn token. Other platforms are unchanged. ([#11535](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11535)) **A process child whose provider has no usable sign-in now moves on to the next provider instead of failing.** When the engine refuses a child's first prompt with `provider_credentials_missing` or `provider_credentials_expired`, the task skips the remaining models on that provider and starts on the next provider in its fallback chain, ending on the parent session's model when nothing else is left. Each hop is recorded as a `task_model_fallback` event naming the provider. An engine that does not send these codes behaves exactly as before. Every other refused first prompt in process mode now also carries the engine's validated error code as `cause_code` in its `task_start_failed` event and in the start-failure message (for example `host_refused: host_memory_pressure`); this is diagnostic only and does not change what the task does. ([#11440](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11440), part of [#10806](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10806)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **A queued steer to a subagent keeps its own id across the child boundary, and a lost acknowledgment is checked before anything is sent again.** A message queued for a child that is still starting reaches it under the id it was queued with, so a drain repeated after a restart replays instead of delivering a second copy. When the child's acknowledgment is lost, omo asks the child whether it holds that id (`get_pending_inputs`): held settles it, not held resends the same id, and an unreadable answer keeps it uncertain instead of guessing. ([#11427](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11427), part of [sisyphuslabs/omo-desktop-app#2838](https://github.com/sisyphuslabs/omo-desktop-app/issues/2838)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Model-profile notices no longer reach the model.** A notice such as "model profile ... has no available model" was sent as part of the conversation, so the model read it ahead of your first message, and on a slow start it could cost an extra model request. The notice now stays out of the conversation: when there is something to do, the desktop app shows it as a notice with the next step (sign in from Provider authentication settings, or choose a model in the composer), and a headless run logs it. ([#11365](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11365)) A stored login that failed while a working provider was used instead still reaches you as a notice naming the provider to re-authenticate, and a profile model the registry no longer finds is reported with the step to choose another model. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Memory read grants now check the file a raw-string tool actually opens.** Containment follows native filesystem traversal before normalizing paths, so a directory symlink followed by `..` cannot redirect a project-memory grant to another identity. Built-in tools retain their resolved-path behavior, missing notes remain readable through their existing canonical ancestor, and case aliases of the same directory remain accepted. ([#11339](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11339)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Completed Momus review verdicts are now persisted as numbered Markdown artifacts next to the plan file.** Each `.omo/plans/{plan}.reviews/NNN-okay.md` or `NNN-reject.md` artifact captures the verdict, timestamp, model, plan sha256, review duration, reviewer session id, and the verdict block (the reasoning that precedes the verdict is not stored), so a finished review survives the end of the session. A `.gitignore` written next to the plans keeps the `.reviews` directories out of the user's own staging area. Momus itself stays read-only; persistence happens entirely on the orchestrator side after the review result returns. ([#11237](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11237), fixes [#3002](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/3002)) Thanks to [@surlymochan](https://github.com/surlymochan) for this contribution. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Release binaries may be up to 200 MiB, and 5.1.49 was not published.** omo 5.1.49's Linux binaries came out over the 182 MiB size budget (linux-x64 200.0 MB, linux-arm64 198.2 MB), so that release stopped before anything was published. The growth is the Bun 1.4.4 runtime itself: an empty compiled Bun program grew from 90.8 MB to 109.1 MB between Bun 1.4.3 and 1.4.4, while everything omo added since 5.1.48 is about 0.46 MB. The budget moves from 182 MiB to 200 MiB so releases keep shipping the Bun version CI tests. ([#11491](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11491)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Every omo.dev page now declares its own language and the dark colour scheme, and starts with a skip link.** Korean, Japanese, Chinese and the other locales set `` to their language (it was always English), form controls and scrollbars render dark, the first Tab offers "Skip to content", focused controls no longer hide under the sticky header, and unknown pages show a 404 in the reader's language. ([#11498](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11498)) **The omo.dev docs search box has a visible edge and a real label.** Its border now meets the 3:1 contrast floor (it was 1.2:1), screen readers announce it as "Filter documentation sections" instead of its placeholder, and the section list has its own name. ([#11492](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11492)) **Icon buttons on omo.dev show their label on keyboard focus, and Escape closes the mobile menu.** The workflow graph's Fit and Center buttons get a real tooltip (shown on hover and focus, dismissed with Escape), and Escape closes the mobile navigation sheet and puts focus back on the menu button. ([#11490](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11490)) **Dimmed graph nodes and quiet labels on omo.dev are readable again.** Nodes off the highlighted path in the workflow graph recede by colour instead of fading to 20% (text contrast goes from 1.1:1 to 5.8:1), and step numbers and the corrected word in the demo no longer use the decoration-only grey. ([#11488](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11488)) **The opencode edition's skill tool no longer repeats skill descriptions OpenCode already lists.** A skill is left out of the skill tool's item list only when OpenCode core's own skill list has the same skill (same name, same file) with a description, so its description is sent once per request instead of twice. Skills core does not list (flat `.md` skills, skills without a name or description, skills core skips because of its disable flags or a custom Claude config dir, OMO-bundled skills) stay in the skill tool's list, and when core's list cannot be read nothing is left out. ([#11456](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11456)) **The provider sign-in page shows the OmO logo.** Every omo launch path (npm, the compiled binary, the local launcher) hands the engine the OmO icon with its brand, so the page a browser shows after signing in to a provider can carry the OmO mark instead of only the name. The logo appears only once omo pins a senpi release that includes senpi#4432/#4434; the currently pinned senpi (2026.10.27-1) ignores it. ([#11445](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11445), fixes [#11444](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11444)) **Release preparation no longer fails its own tests.** The changelog stamp-agreement test read `changes/unreleased` unconditionally; a release-state tree has consumed every fragment and has no such directory, so the test crashed on every release PR. It now reads the real fragments only when the directory exists. ([#11443](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11443)) **LazyCodex bug-fix skills now send fixes to the repository that owns the source.** `lcx-contribute-bug-fix` told agents that a LazyCodex-owned defect must become a verified-fix issue carrying the patch on the `code-yeongyu/lazycodex` mirror, so a fix that already sat as an open lead PR here was filed a second time as a full diff on the mirror. The skill now searches the author's own open PRs across repos first, then opens a fork PR against `code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent` (base `dev`, `packages/omo-codex/plugin/...` paths, changelog fragment); the mirror gets no PR and at most a short issue that links it. `lcx-report-bug` routes fixes the same way. Upstream `openai/codex` routing is unchanged. ([#11410](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11410)) **Research fact locators now bind to original snapshot bytes.** Source snapshots retain the fetched bytes as `raw.bin`; a `--text` file alone becomes a converted-only source that supports warned quotations but no measured rows, and `--raw --text ` keeps the original next to a declared extraction. Page locators read only reader-visible text nodes (never attributes, scripts, styles, or hidden elements), record byte offsets in the source's own encoding, and `fact verify` fails closed when a cited snapshot cannot be read. The new `source refresh` command repins a re-fetched source and re-anchors its rows by quote and context; a legacy row on a refreshed source is listed as not re-anchored and blocks verification instead of passing unchecked. ([#11287](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11287)) **Research collection now catches numbers that text conversion changed, and refuses to register them.** `source probe-conversion` compares numeric multisets with one grouped-number grammar (a footnote digit glued onto `12,345` is reported; a lone `1.234` is a decimal), never groups digits across a table cell, row, list item or line break, lets digits copied from link targets, image sources, alt text and titles cover only numbers inside Markdown link or image syntax, treats a converter's ordered-list markers (only where the source has that `
    ` item, lazy `1. 1. 1.` numbering included), numeric reference-link labels, footnote-definition labels and hard-wrapped digit groups as conversion syntax rather than numbers, reads a sign through the emphasis, code, titled-link, image and escape markup a converter adds (`**2019**-2023` is a range), decodes named references with one table on both sides (`−`, ` `), reads the raw inline HTML a converter keeps (`10-5`, a sized ``) as the source's own tags, accepts a reference title on the next line, and counts a minus touching Korean text, a single letter or an exponent, or written as an en dash. `source snapshot` prints the altered numbers, and `fact add` refuses a value its source's conversion altered with `conversion_altered_number`; the recovery is `source snapshot --id S --text --replace`, refused while an active row cites the source. The fact-ledger reference declares the probe's guaranteed scope and lists what is out of scope (shortcodes, LaTeX, non-CommonMark tables), which always reports as altered. Both research editions describe this flow; their existing phase instructions now live in focused references. ([#11286](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11286)) **Skill MCP clients can use MCP 2026-07-28 servers.** Modern servers receive discovery and per-request protocol metadata without an initialization handshake. Input-required operations stop with a clear error because skill MCP does not support elicitation. Legacy servers receive a discovery probe before their existing initialization negotiation; a timed-out probe logs the fallback and is paid only once per server per process, because later connects to that server go straight to legacy initialization (a failed legacy initialization forgets it), and unsupported-version fallback preserves the legacy server's capabilities and identity. ([#11243](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11243), part of [#11205](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11205)) **The desktop-engine MCP server also serves MCP 2026-07-28 clients.** Discovery and per-request protocol metadata work without initialization; modern results identify the server and complete result type, and tool lists include cache hints. Unsupported request versions are rejected before daemon access, notifications receive no reply, and legacy initialization keeps its existing supported-version negotiation. ([#11239](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11239), part of [#11205](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11205)) ### Fixed - Atlas schedules its delayed boulder-continuation retry through an injectable scheduler (default: the real timer), and its tests drive that scheduler instead of patching global timers, so a whole-suite run no longer fires other modules' timers in the retry tests ([#11619](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11619), fixes [#11617](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11617)) - Cancelling a prompt now stops an in-flight skill MCP call: `skill_mcp` passes the session abort signal to the MCP request, which rejects at once with the abort reason, and an HTTP MCP server's request and SSE stream are closed instead of staying open until the connection is torn down ([#11592](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11592)) - The Prometheus planning-file guard resolves Windows paths the way the executor opens them: both `/` and `\` split the physical walk, so a `link/..` spelling is followed through the link instead of being collapsed lexically (a symlink escape was allowed), a symlinked or junctioned planning directory such as `.omo -> docs\plans` is recognised again, and 8.3 short names, drive-letter case and directory case all resolve to one canonical path. Inside-planning checks compare the canonical paths exactly, which keeps case-variant entries on case-sensitive directories distinct ([#11548](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11548)) - A ChatGPT subscription whose sign-in refresh fails only briefly at session start (connection refused, timeout, a 408/429/5xx from the token endpoint) now stays selected in the model profile. Before, the session moved to the next provider, for example a configured OpenAI API key, and stayed on that metered lane until it was restarted. A refused refresh still skips the provider with the re-authenticate notice, a credential failure seen while re-checking the model still skips the provider with the matching notice, a model whose own request headers fail to resolve is still skipped, and a candidate kept while its refresh is still unresolved logs one warning with the error class and transport code so a later first-turn failure can be traced ([#11442](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11442), fixes [#11432](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11432)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) - `omo logout` now leaves a small sign-out note (no credentials, just the device and the time), so OmO Desktop can tell a deliberate sign-out from a credential store that hasn't answered yet. `omo account token` and `export` report it with exit code 10; exit 4 still means nothing could be read. Signing in again removes the note. The note is written before the credentials are removed, so a failed write leaves you signed in and `omo logout` reports the error; a damaged note is ignored (exit 4) and never breaks `omo account show`. ([#11441](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11441), fixes [#11434](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11434)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) - A workflow (DAG) category node whose whole model chain is spent or signed out now finishes on the parent session's model, the same last rung a `task` child gets. The model is captured when the workflow starts and kept on the run, so retried and recovered nodes keep it too. ([#11439](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11439)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) - Prometheus checks and executes the same authorized planning-file path, including relative symlink/`..` paths, aliased project roots, hashline renames, and patch moves. Patch headers must round-trip through the supported executor parser without changing authorized operations or targets. Rename/delete preserve named final links; content writes follow only allowed targets. The physical planning directory may have any name the user chose (for example `.omo -> docs/plans`) but must be strictly inside the real project root, never the root itself or an ancestor; a `.omo` path segment matches with filesystem-native casing. Every denial is logged with its specific reason. Nested plans and parent-folder Windows paths remain supported; required argument rewrites fail closed if the host's retained arguments cannot receive them ([#11424](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11424)) - Bundled skills no longer ship a top-level `__tests__` or `*_test` folder. Only a skill's top-level `test/` and `tests/` folders are exempt from the test-folder filter; before, any top-level folder name escaped it. ([#11398](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11398), fixes [#11393](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11393)) - Prometheus now checks every `apply_patch` Add, Update, Delete, and Move target using the executor's line-splitting and header-slicing rules, including carriage returns and Unicode line separators; empty or unclassifiable headers fail closed ([#11392](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11392)) - Prometheus allows plan updates beside Markdown horizontal rules and triple-emphasized text by treating Update context as content, while still checking subsequent mutation headers ([#11392](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11392)) - `omo run` starts its OpenCode server with a per-run password when `OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD` is not set, so a web page on another localhost port can no longer drive it; attaching to that server from outside the run now needs the password ([#11370](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11370)) - Authenticated tmux panes receive credentials through owner-only, one-use files instead of process arguments; run cleanup removes any unread files ([#11370](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11370)). - Research fidelity verification now blocks only the facts whose source snapshot is unreadable, names the cause, accepts grouped derived values such as "3,234 KRW-e8" exactly as fill writes them, and detects edits to the original value or unit shown beside a conversion, in any bracket style (ASCII, fullwidth, square, lenticular, corner or tortoise-shell), a missing or misplaced original, a non-numeric bracket, a dash in place of brackets, and a second original (a bare figure in the operand's dimension right after the conversion), in HTML and Markdown editions; another filled fact, a parenthetical figure in prose, a year, or a range after a conversion no longer blocks an untampered report. ([#11310](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11310)) - Verified and assumed claim placeholders now fill with their claim marks in HTML and Markdown verification; format guidance reflects Markdown support. ([#11310](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11310)) - Research fidelity verification binds the unit written right after a value-only fact, with or without a space and with a Korean particle, a currency sign before it, its unit placeholder, or its table column header by visual column, so hand-edited units block and ordinary prose such as "m in total length" no longer raises a false unit mismatch. A scale word inside the value ("3,234억", "12 million") is part of the value, and a row header in a key/value table is never read as a column header. A qualifier after the value ("초과", "이상", "or more") or an ordinary word that is also a unit alias ("won awards", "second place") is never read as a unit; a unit wrapped in inline markup, in parentheses or after a line break is read; and fill records each value's bound unit, mode included, in the fill map, so an edit to an unknown unit, a deleted unit, or a deleted `data-fact-mode` attribute still blocks. The longest unit written after a value is the one checked, so a longer unit that starts with the row's unit ("12% 포인트", "12 percent points" for a row in %) blocks, and an ordinary unit word beside a currency sign of another currency ("$320 pounds") blocks. ([#11301](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11301)) - First-person verification cues ("we verified", "we double-checked", and the Korean equivalents) warn only when the clause names a result and no document before the clause ends ("We measured a latency of 40 ms, as this report shows." and "We verified the value on page 3." warn); one cue list covers English and Korean. ([#11301](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11301)) - Research fidelity verification now matches complete source revisions (a sentence-final period included), reports a missing operand timestamp and a missing operand row under their own codes instead of a window mismatch, and reads quoted CSV labels correctly. ([#11290](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11290)) - Polished report editions retain their original brief binding in a separate `.polished.fill-map.json`, the pre-polish fill map is never rewritten (so `fact pairs --changed-since` still re-checks every sentence that changed, including after polishing in place), a fill map that does not match the report is refused, and editions without a fill map cannot bypass a changed brief. ([#11290](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11290)) - Fact derivation requires caller-supplied observation time (`fact derive --now`; without it the command refuses with `missing_now`) and preserves ledger validation errors. Quote exact rules, negative zero, source-value rendering, placeholder identifiers, and literal-brace guidance are corrected. ([#11290](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11290)) ### Added - CI now fails a pull request that adds an unused file, an unused export, an unused dependency, or an unlisted or unresolved import (`bun run knip:check`, knip 6.43.0).
